correctness.rationale: The standard rank-two automorphism matrix reduces exact fixed-subgroup order p to three mutually exclusive residue patterns on the socle. In the first two patterns one diagonal difference is a unit, so the kernel reduces to a single cyclic congruence and exact order p is the valuation-one condition. The third pattern can have exact order p only when both off-diagonal residues are nonzero and the exponent gap is one; otherwise the kernel has at least p^2 elements. The line type follows from the induced lower-triangular socle action. Direct exhaustive enumeration in seven cases verifies every formula and the published C_p plus C_p^2 total.

originality.rationale: Mozafar--Taeri classify which subgroups occur as automorphism fixed subgroups but do not count the automorphism fiber over a prescribed subgroup. Hayat--López-Aguayo--Abbas count by fixed-subgroup order, including the special C_p plus C_p^2 case, but do not resolve individual order-p subgroup fibers in the inspected text. The new statement is strictly finer: it separates the characteristic long-factor line from the p other socle lines and gives exact multiplicities for arbitrary unequal exponents.

value.rationale: The fixed-point map is the organizing object of the primary Acentralizer paper, so determining the size of its fibers is a natural refinement of its existence theorem. The result reveals a genuine asymmetry invisible to theta(G,p): one characteristic order-p line carries a larger automorphism fiber than the p conjugate finite-slope lines. It also gives the exact characteristic-two collapse and recovers the published C_p plus C_p^2 total as a consistency check.
